'''813A''' was the sole [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thrantin]]. The [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]] occasionally used the moon for zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] training when Thrantin's [[grav regulator]]s were not working.
